name: scm-syncfusion-react-poc
description: SCM POC: React + Syncfusion (Grid custom binding with 1L records, Pivot, Chart, Gantt, Schedule, Diagram) with JWT login

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.build: npm --prefix client run build && node scripts/prepare-azure-deploy.cjs && npm install --prefix client/dist --omit=dev --package-lock=false
scripts.preview: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm:server" "npm --prefix client run preview"
